title: crataegus monogyna var. azarella
intro: Crataegus monogyna var. azarella, commonly known as the Hawthorn berry, is a variety of hawthorn plant, which is a deciduous shrub or small tree with sharp thorns. The health benefits of Crataegus monogyna var. azarella include its ability to support cardiovascular health by lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its potential to improve cognitive function and reduce anxiety. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its vasodilatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect the heart and blood vessels from damage. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus monogyna var. azarella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
